I told Hollis in a thread on her message in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.

That number comes from Tobias, who posted it in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel since has changed it. Hollis is a member of that channel, so she could already see it, and a seat count isn't a finance figure. I couldn't find any Marrow Agrisupply files in the shared drive to check it against, so I suggested she confirm with Tobias that it's final.
